repos_data.description: SRS is a simple, high-efficiency, real-time media server supporting RTMP, WebRTC, HLS, HTTP-FLV, HTTP-TS, SRT, MPEG-DASH, and GB28181, with codec support for H.264, H.265, AV1, VP9, AAC, Opus, and G.711.
Ready-to-use SRT / WebRTC / RTSP / RTMP / LL-HLS / MPEG-TS / RTP media server and media proxy that allows to read, publish, proxy, record and playback video and audio streams.
Take control over your live stream video by running it yourself.  Streaming + chat out of the box.

The Restreamer is a complete streaming server solution for self-hosting. It has a visually appealing user interface and no ongoing license costs.
